resources.string: The launcher icon uses one of its built-in colours and is not affected by the system theme or by Reset colours. To have it follow your wallpaper instead, turn on themed icons in your launcher\'s settings.
Colours come from your wallpaper through the system theme. Turn this off to pick the colours below.
Text colour matched the background so it stays readable
Background colour matched the text so it stays readable
Flips the two colours, the quickest way between a light and a dark screen. The pair stays just as readable.
